page.title: Restock sessions
page.intro: A session is one restocking period. Starting a new one ends the previous one, and everything received or sold in between is counted in that session.

sessions.noneOpen: No session is open right now.
sessions.empty: No restock sessions yet. Start one when a delivery comes in.
sessions.name: Session #{number}
sessions.closeDescription: Receives from now on won't belong to any session until a new one starts. Its report stops counting at this moment.

report.label: Session #{number} report
report.empty: Nothing was received or sold during this session.
report.revenueNote: Revenue is what customers paid at each sale.
report.revenueNoteEstimated: Revenue is what customers paid at each sale. ≈ marks items with sales from before prices were recorded, valued at today's price.

startDialog.title: Start a restock session
startDialog.endsCurrent: This ends the session that opened {time}. Everything received from now on is logged to the new one.
startDialog.noCurrent: Everything received from now on is logged to this session, until the next one starts.
startDialog.noteHint: Optional, e.g. the supplier or delivery.

banner.label: Restock session
banner.since: Since {date} ({ago}). Everything you receive is logged to it.
banner.adminHint: Start one to group this delivery's receives for reporting.
banner.sellerHint: Receives still count; an admin can start a session to group them.

compare.lengths: Lengths: {a} vs {b}. Per day divides by each session's length (anything under a day counts as one day), so sessions of different lengths compare fairly.
compare.needTwo: Comparing needs at least two sessions. Start another one when the next delivery comes in.

insights.empty: No sessions yet. Insights appear once sessions have sales in them.
insights.estimatedNote: ≈ revenue includes sales from before prices were recorded, valued at today's price
insights.trendNote: Totals per session, not per day — longer sessions naturally sell more. Compare per day on the Compare tab.
